reviewer: Codex agent; actual eight-frame sequences redecoded with frozen sampler and checked against persisted actual timestamps; raw pixels and center-crop geometry; no independent human sign-off
review_method: At least one annotated-occurrence context and Top-1 sampled sequence per missed query. Additional occurrences reviewed when evidence sufficiency was uncertain. Sheets are not continuous playback; center-crop geometry previews do not replicate pixel interpolation/normalization.

queries.query: Workers roll large cotton bales along the boat ramp.
queries.observation: Eight frames show workers rolling cotton bales on the ramp (344.255-347.758s). Top 1 at 744s shows other bales moving on an inclined conveyor/ramp with a worker's hand. The mechanical transport differs from the frozen occurrence, but the wording may admit that visually similar operation. Potential missing alternate occurrence/wording ambiguity is disclosed; frozen labels and raw miss are unchanged.

queries.query: A tall tree falls down in the forest.
queries.observation: The 556.267-559.770s sequence contains leaning/falling trunks and moving branches, retained by center crop. Top 1 shows already cut logs moving in water rather than a standing tree falling.

queries.query: Bare hillsides and dead tree stumps after deforestation.
queries.observation: Bare slope and dead stumps are clearly visible throughout the 854.264-857.768s sequence. Top 1 midpoint 818s is just before the frozen 819s onset and contains boundary-context hillside frames; this could be a useful near-event click but is not a primary timestamp hit. Eligible window at 820s is rank 8; truth/tolerance unchanged.

queries.query: The woodworker tips the carved log from upright onto its side.
queries.observation: The sampled sequence at 134.251-137.771s shows the upright-to-side transition, including 135.771s. However neither frozen short interval contains any 2-second-grid window midpoint, so this query is unrepresentable under the frozen primary timestamp metric. Top 1 also shows unrelated early chainsaw cutting. This is timestamp coverage, not absence of sampled pixels.
